subject: Hash HRANDFIELD and SRANDMEMBER temporary tables case-sensitively (#5167)
reason: This is a pure performance fix with no observable behaviour change. It switches the temporary SRANDMEMBER/HRANDFIELD reply hashtable (sdsReplyHashtableType) from a case-insensitive hash function (dictSdsCaseHash) to a case-sensitive one (dictSdsHash), while keeping the case-sensitive comparator. The old case-insensitive-hash/case-sensitive-compare combination was already correctness-safe: distinct case variants still compared unequal, so all elements were inserted as distinct entries, every hashtableAdd succeeded, and the size asserts held.
